verdict.rationale: Mailgun offers a Postman collection with pre-built, runnable requests and example values (mailgun-docs-16, mailgun-docs-41), which provides some runnable-example capability, but there's no evidence of an embedded interactive API reference (e.g., Swagger/OpenAPI 'try it' UI) — the openapi.json probe returned 404s across all candidate paths. missing for 10: native in-docs interactive console, OpenAPI/Swagger spec, live 'try it' execution in the reference itself.
